purpose: Define a versioned, product- and domain-neutral, fail-closed evidence input for qualified review of whether a concrete distribution, modification, branding, or fine-tuning fact pattern needs GPAI-provider-obligation assessment. It records evidence and reassessment work only; it does not determine provider status, legal applicability, an obligation, compliance, deployment authorization, release, authority, or runtime operation.

authoritative_external_reference.review_references: Article 3(63) and Article 53 are qualified-review references only; their applicability and interpretation depend on current, deployment-specific qualified review.

architecture_boundary.product_boundary: Neural Brain is the complete protected cognitive system under ADR-018; the Memory Core is a protected internal subsystem.
architecture_boundary.control_plane: Only separately governed Protected Control Plane and release processes may decide protected state, authority, deployment, or external effects.
architecture_boundary.stage_boundary: This evidence template implements no NB-stage capability and cannot compensate for absent delivery, evaluation, recognition, safety, or control evidence.

verified_facts: The repository is product- and domain-neutral and records no accepted scoped customer or domain integration.
The repository has no approved productive model deployment or runtime inference adapter.
The model and inference inventory is evidence-only and cannot activate, deploy, promote, or authorize a model or inference provider.
No repository artifact currently establishes a concrete distribution, modification, branding, fine-tuning, market-placement, putting-into-service, or GPAI-provider fact pattern.
unknown_facts_not_inferred: whether any entity is a GPAI provider for a concrete model or deployment
whether a concrete model is a GPAI model or is made available on the Union market
whether a concrete distribution, modification, branding, fine-tuning, or downstream release creates a legal obligation
the accountable legal entity, brand, terms, recipients, jurisdictions, and market or output nexus for a concrete artifact
whether any Article 53 obligation applies, is met, or is exempted
whether any deployment, release, model activation, authority, or external effect is authorized

assessment_template.record_semantics: One immutable assessment record binds one model or GPAI-boundary artifact digest to one concrete distribution and operating context. It is an evidence intake and has no allow outcome.
required_comparisons: Compare the immutable model or artifact digest with the linked model-inference inventory record; mutable tags, repository visibility, branch names, or self-description are insufficient.
Compare actual distribution, modification, fine-tuning, branding, entity, terms, and jurisdiction facts against the exact intended-purpose and AI Act role-assessment records.
Keep potential GPAI-provider-obligation review separate from operator-role, risk-classification, licence, security, privacy, authority, release, and runtime decisions.
Record every model, supplier, distribution, modification, fine-tuning, branding, purpose, jurisdiction, or legal-source change through the separately governed reassessment-trigger intake.

authority_boundary.template_is: a versioned governance and traceability input for qualified, deployment-specific GPAI-provider-obligation review
template_is_not: an Article 53 applicability or obligation conclusion
a maturity, recognition, safety, or production-autonomy claim
authority_boundary.release_boundary: Only separately authorized release governance, qualified current review, and all applicable Protected Control Plane, Security Floor, delivery-stage, evaluation, and evidence requirements may decide a concrete deployment.
